blocks.html: "Mandatory front building wall lines" are imaginary lines extending through Zone A and Zone C of the Special Battery Park City District which, except as shown in Appendices 2.1 and 3.1 of this Chapter, coincide with street lines and with which building walls must generally coincide, as provided in Sections 84-132 and 84-332 (Mandatory front building walls).
blocks.plainText: "Mandatory front building wall lines" are imaginary lines extending through Zone A and Zone C of the Special Battery Park City District which, except as shown in Appendices 2.1 and 3.1 of this Chapter, coincide with street lines and with which building walls must generally coincide, as provided in Sections 84-132 and 84-332 (Mandatory front building walls).

blocks.html: "Special height locations" are designated areas in Zone A and Zone C of the Special Battery Park City District subject to the regulations in Appendices 2.2 and 3.2 of this Chapter, in accordance with Sections 84-135 and 84-333 (Limited height of buildings).
